name: bett3r-pv4
description: The pv4 + Blueprint plugin: skills for designing and building pv4 apps on a Blueprint board. Today it holds `framework-adapter`, the vocabulary that maps a pv4 manifest (`pv4.yaml`) onto the board's eight kinds and names nodes the way pv4 does, read by a Blueprint design run on a pv4 repository before it models. It carries vocabulary only; the design method stays in Blueprint.
